title: androsace occidentalis subsp. acuta
intro: Androsace occidentalis subsp. acuta, commonly known as Western rock jasmine or western pygmy-pink, is a species of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, primarily due to its high content of bioactive constituents, which provide various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Androsace occidentalis subsp. acuta include wound healing, anti-cancer properties, and its ability to regulate blood sugar levels. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
